name: network-review-fails-user-declines
about: Build tools on, search off, ask_claude off. The model asks to install a package with the network; the reviewer's first request gets HTTP 400 (an older server), the retry without response_format and chat_template_kwargs gets HTTP 503, so the review fails and the user is asked; the user declines and the command does not run. Covers the retry body and the question after a failed review.

stream.content: You declined network access, so nothing was installed.
